Welcome
Welcome to Salisbury Primary School’s Website
I am proud to work alongside our governors, parents and staff enabling us to provide our pupils with the skills and confidence to be lifelong learners.
At Salisbury, we provide an inspiring cross curricular approach to learning which draws upon the rich cultural community we serve and celebrates diversity in all its forms.
Our website celebrates the range of opportunities that broaden the knowledge and skills both within and beyond the school day.
We build strong partnerships with our families through the provision of care from 6 months to 11 years of age. Working parents are able to access our wrap around care with the knowledge that their children are in a safe, secure learning environment.
I hope our website makes you feel excited and want to continue exploring all we have to offer.
Why don’t you come and visit our school to see for yourself?
Head Teacher (BSc with Hons, NPQH)
